lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Multiplicative Comparison, Factors, Multiples, and Patterns
lessonRef.focus: generating a number pattern from a rule and describing a feature the rule does not state
lessonRef.title: Concept extension: generating a number pattern from a rule and describing a feature the rule does not state

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example applies the idea in a new setting. Notice what stayed the same.

items.prompt: The pattern 2, 4, 8, 16, ... follows the rule "multiply by 2 each time." What is the 5th term?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what is different about this case before you start.

items.prompt: The pattern 7, 14, 28, 56, ... follows the rule "multiply by 2 each time." What is the 5th term?
The pattern 7, 15, 23, 31, ... follows the rule "add 8 each time." What is the 6th term?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: The pattern 6, 12, 24, 48, ... follows the rule "multiply by 2 each time." What is the 5th term?
The pattern 3, 9, 15, 21, ... follows the rule "add 6 each time." What is the 5th term?
The pattern 8, 12, 16, 20, ... follows the rule "add 4 each time." What is the 6th term?
The pattern 6, 11, 16, 21, ... follows the rule "add 5 each time." What is the 6th term?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain, in writing, what made this case different from the original one.

items.prompt: The pattern 5, 9, 13, 17, ... follows the rule "add 4 each time." What is the 6th term?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: The pattern 2, 4, 8, 16, ... follows the rule "multiply by 2 each time." What is the 6th term?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
